title: Signature Wrong-Slot Hardening
lede: Two MBB players signed in the wrong roster slots on 2026-09-03. These changes make a wrong slot visible before Save, make the fix a roster action instead of raw SQL, and let staff add players missing from the official roster without a later import dropping them.

sections.heading: Capture canvas
sections.note: After only. No pre-change capture was taken; the earlier canvas showed the name only as small header text. iPad user agent emulated in Playwright at 1180×820 CSS px against the branch preview (synthetic MHKY data).

shots.title: Signer line
shots.cap: The signer's name and number sit on the signature line, where the signer is looking. It is an overlay and never part of the saved strokes.

sections.heading: Fixing a wrong slot
sections.note: After only, same preview session. A test signature was saved to #2 Luke Osburn through the save API, then moved through the UI.

shots.title: Move dialog
shots.cap: Row menu → **Move signature to…** shows the saved ink and lists only active people with no signature history.

shots.title: Roster after the move
shots.cap: The signature and its history now belong to Braeden Carrington; Luke Osburn is blank and needs to sign again.

shots.title: Add player
shots.cap: Team rosters get **Add player** for someone on the team but not on the official roster. The row carries an **Unofficial** badge.

changes.h: Wrong slot was easy to miss
changes.was: The name was small text in the header, away from where the signer writes.
changes.now: Name and number on the signature line, plus a prompt to check it before saving.

changes.h: Correcting a wrong slot took raw production SQL
changes.was: Reassigning captures meant hand-written SQL against production.
changes.now: An audited **Move signature to…** action moves the whole capture, with its original revisions, to a blank person. It checks versions, blocks during live saves, excludes shared Creative Staff signatures, and leaves the source blank so stale drafts can't save onto it.

changes.was: Apply deactivated every member missing from the snapshot, including staff-added ones.
changes.now: Apply deactivates only imported members, and adopts a staff-added player by unique name if they later appear officially.

changes.h: No way to add an off-roster player to a team
changes.was: Only the ad-hoc collection took manual signers.
changes.now: Add player on team rosters, seeded from the previous season when the name is unique; a removed same-name player is reactivated instead of duplicated.

verification: Signature suites: 129/129 pass, including 11 new service regressions (move guards, server-owned move eligibility including erased history, apply keeps and adopts unofficial members, add player seeding, reactivation, stale and non-team rejection).
Full vitest: 1 failure in tests/ios-accessibility-layout-hardening.test.ts, from iOS Welcome Swift edits already in the working tree before this session; all other tests pass.
TypeScript, scoped ESLint, and build:app pass.

Authenticated branch preview (Playwright, admin): Add player created an Unofficial #1; Move changed the collection from version 4 to 5, the target got the original revision, the source went blank at capture version 2; the picker offered 26 eligible people and excluded the signed row. No console errors.
notes: No before captures: the baseline would need a second preview server on an isolated copy of the pre-change tree.
Not deployed. Production still runs the old code, where an official MBB 2026-27 Apply would deactivate Carrington.
No physical iPad or Apple Pencil check; the iPad was emulated by user agent.
